subject: Redwood confirmation: geographic hosting commitment and private connectivity controls
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@medallionhealth.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Chu <lauren.chu@medallionhealth.com>, legal@medallionhealth.com
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: confirmation of geo-hosting & private connectivity controls for Medallion POC

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're starting the technical intake for the Medallion POC (PHI-scoped) and need a short, signed confirmation of Redwood's regional hosting and private connectivity controls before we can open our procurement request. Specifically we need answers to the following so our InfoSec and Procurement teams can triage: 

- Will Medallion data for the POC be processed and stored exclusively in the EU (eu-central-1) for the production-like environment?
- Is there any automated cross-region failover that could move customer data to a non-EU region (e.g., US) without an explicit manual failover?
- For private deployments: do you support a VPC-style private endpoint (PrivateLink / dedicated peering) and can you provide a high-level config snippet or diagram showing the network boundary?
- KMS: will customer-managed keys be physically scoped/partitioned to the EU region?
- SOC 2 scope: will logs/audit trails for this deployment be accessible for review (we may ask for a SOC 2 carve-out or SOC 2 attestations)?

A short one-page commitment and a diagram would be ideal. If you can also indicate turnaround for a signed PDF, that would help us set expectations internally.

Best,
Samir
Samir Patel
Head of IT Security, Medallion Health
samir.patel@medallionhealth.com
+44 20 5555 0123
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@medallionhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: confirmation of geo-hosting & private connectivity controls for Medallion POC

Hi Samir —

Thanks for outlining the asks. We can provide a short, signed "Geographic Commitment & Private Connectivity" letter plus a diagram and a minimal config snippet that shows how the VPC/private endpoint is intended to be wired. High-level answers up front:

- EU-only processing: For Private deployments we can pin the deployment to eu-central-1 and ensure control plane access is restricted from outside the EU for the pinned cluster.
- Cross-region failover: There is no automated cross-region failover enabled for reserved/private clusters by default. Any cross-region failover is a manual, controlled operation that requires approvals and would be documented in the runbook we provide.
- Private connectivity: We support AWS PrivateLink and dedicated VPC peering topologies. We'll provide a diagram (attachment) and a small config snippet showing expected route table and security group boundaries.
- KMS: We support customer-managed KMS with keys created in the customer's EU account/region; our integrations are configured to use region-scoped keys.
- SOC 2 / logs: We can provide scoped audit evidence and log exports for the cluster covering the timeframe requested; SOC 2 reports can be provided under NDA or via our secure customer portal.

Next steps: I'll attach the diagram and a VPC snippet for your team to review. If Medallion requires a signed PDF, we can route a one-page commitment via DocuSign once we agree on the final wording. Monica (CS) and Sergio (sales) are looped to help with the contract and signature logistics.

I will attach: redwood_region_boundary_diagram.pdf and a vpc_peering_config_snippet.txt for your architecture team.

Would you like the document to explicitly state "no automated cross-region failover" and "KMS keys remain in customer EU account"? If so we'll prepare the PDF and a DocuSign link.

Regards,
Markus Klein
Director, Solutions Engineering | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@medallionhealth.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Chu <lauren.chu@medallionhealth.com>, legal@medallionhealth.com
Date: Tue, 8 Dec 2026 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: confirmation of geo-hosting & private connectivity controls for Medallion POC

Markus — thanks. A couple clarifications from our side before we finalize: 

1) For the "no automated cross-region failover" statement, can you confirm whether any control-plane telemetry, metrics, or crash-dump artifacts are ever uploaded to a US central analytics service outside the EU (even if payloads are anonymized)? We need assurance that event/telemetry pipelines are region-bounded.

2) For PrivateLink/VPC peering: does Redwood terminate the peering on a shared tenant gateway that is multi-tenant, or is the peering to an instance/edge that is dedicated per customer? 

3) Timeline: what is the expected turnaround once we sign? We need the signed commitment in < 5 business days to keep our RFP calendar.

If you can answer this inline we can circle back with legal about the DocuSign flow.

Thanks,
Samir
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@medallionhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Lauren Chu <lauren.chu@medallionhealth.com>, legal@medallionhealth.com
Date: Wed, 9 Dec 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: confirmation of geo-hosting & private connectivity controls for Medallion POC

Samir —

Thanks for the follow-ups. Answers below; I've also attached a one-page signed commitment PDF for Medallion and the diagram/snippet from my earlier note. Attachment list: redwood_region_boundary_diagram.pdf, vpc_peering_config_snippet.txt, signed-commitment.pdf (attached).

1) Telemetry & control-plane artifacts: For Private deployments we can configure the control plane and telemetry ingestion to remain within the EU region. By default our hosted analytics backend is multi-region, but for Private deployments we provide a region-scoped telemetry option that keeps logs, metrics, and crash artifacts in the customer's EU bucket/account. We'll include a short runbook excerpt that shows the telemetry endpoints and S3/KMS partitioning.

2) Peering termination model: For Dedicated/Private customers we do not use a shared multi-tenant gateway for traffic termination. The peering is terminated on a customer-isolated endpoint (either PrivateLink endpoint service or dedicated peering to tenant-dedicated edge) — the configuration snippet shows the expected attachment/ENI arrangement. This ensures network traffic does not traverse a shared tenant gateway.

3) Timeline: Once Medallion confirms the commitment language we can generate the DocuSign envelope. Typical turnaround for signed commitment is 1-2 business days; provisioning of the pinned private cluster (post-contract) is 5-7 business days depending on capacity scheduling. If you need the commitment signed inside 5 business days we can prioritize the envelope.

If this looks good I'll send the DocuSign link and Monica will coordinate a short MSA/ordering statement.

Best,
Markus Klein
Director, Solutions Engineering | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com
